children: UK digital transformation firm's H1 revenue rose 60% yr/yr to £57.9 mln
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 up 152% to £8.0 mln, margin increased to 13.9%
Company moved to net cash of £1.0 mln, eliminating net debt during the period
TPXimpact reaffirms FY27 guidance for revenue of at least £105m
Company expects FY27 adjusted EBITDA of at least £14m
TPXimpact says trading in October has been strong, continuing year-to-date trend
NEW CONTRACT WINS - Co said strong new business wins, particularly with UK government departments and public sector clients, drove revenue growth
CLIENT DEMAND - Co attributed growth to robust demand from existing and new public sector clients, with 94% of revenue from public sector and 70% from central government
COST MANAGEMENT - Co said adjusted EBITDA growth was supported by close management of central costs and operational leverage as the business scaled
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tpximpact Holdings PLC is GBp150.00, about 39.5% above its November 9 closing price of GBp107.50
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
